2608.19888.title: Evidence Before Expansion: Reuse, Spawn, or Defer in Lifelong Expert Pools
2608.19888.paper_summary: Streaming systems that maintain a pool of expert models must repeatedly decide whether to reuse an existing expert for arriving data, spawn a new one, or defer. We present a decision layer that makes all three outcomes statistically meaningful. Reuse and spawn are posed as one-sided sequential hypotheses on a conditional (mechanism-level) discrepancy, separated by an indifference zone; defer is exactly the state in which neither betting e-process has accumulated sufficient evidence. We prove finite-time anytime validity for the observable surrogate discrepancy of a predictable discriminator sequence, and an unconditional one-sided transfer to the population quantity in which each side's slack is the excess risk of a single discriminator; an empirically observed downward-bias regularity makes the spawn side exactly conservative. Recency without sacrificing the guarantee is obtained by a restarted e-detector: a bank of unwindowed betting supermartingales at geometrically spaced restart times (O(log t) memory), with the error budget spent over restart instances, which preserves lifetime anytime validity; spending over expert-creation order likewise controls multiplicity for unboundedly many experts. On synthetic multi-concept streams, Electricity, Covertype, and the recurrence-heavy INSECTS benchmark, the instance-accounted restarted bank achieves zero false spawns and zero false reuses after switches and matches or exceeds the retired windowed heuristic (INSECTS-reoccurring accuracy 0.675), making the deployed algorithm and the guaranteed algorithm one and the same.
2608.19888.paper_summary_zh: 流媒體系統維護一組專家模型，必須不斷決定是否重用現有專家來處理到達的數據、產生新的專家，或是延遲。我們提出了一個決策層，使這三種結果在統計上都有意義。重用和產生被視為在條件（機制級別）差異上的單側序列假設，並由一個無差異區域分隔；延遲正是兩個投注e過程都未積累足夠證據的狀態。我們證明了可觀察的替代差異對於可預測的判別序列在有限時間內的隨時有效性，以及對於每一方的鬆弛是單一判別器的過度風險的無條件單側轉移到總體數量；經驗觀察到的向下偏差規律使得產生方完全保守。通過重啟的e檢測器獲得近期性而不犧牲保證：在幾何間隔的重啟時間（O(log t) 記憶）下，無窗口的投注超馬丁格爾銀行，錯誤預算在重啟實例中花費，這保持了終身隨時有效性；在專家創建順序上花費同樣控制了無界多個專家的多重性。在合成多概念流中，電力、隱蔽類型和重複性強的INSECTS基準，實例計算的重啟銀行在切換後實現了零虛假產生和零虛假重用，或匹配並超過了退休的窗口啟發式（INSECTS重現準確率0.675），使得部署的算法和保證的算法實際上是一致的。
2608.19888.author: Kentaro Oda et.al.
